name: web-clean-blog-article-page-with-blurred-green-gradient-and-tag-sidebar
title: Blog article page with sage gradient, large sans title, meta pills, rounded hero photo and tag sidebar
whatItIs: A white page over a blurred green gradient with a green logo and nav (active underlined with a dot), breadcrumb, large title, meta pills (author, category, read time, date, heart), a rounded hero photo of a man with a laptop through plants, body text and a right sidebar with share icons, tags, related posts and more tags.
whatItMeans: Clear and modern; soft pills and a plant photo make business content feel calm.
techniques: Show article meta in soft pills.
Add a sidebar of tags and related posts.
Use a blurred gradient behind the page.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule showing author, time or date.
A list of thumbnails with titles.
A dot under the current menu item.
